provenance.commit_label: P5X Checkpoint A: pre-result temporal anchor
provenance.quoted_rationale: the required half-width for P5X-T4 is < 0.2. That margin is the campaign's central engineering bet, and step 3 of PROOF_OBLIGATIONS.md section 4 tests it on a single cell before any scaling.
provenance.stop_gate_wording: If the achieved width exceeds 0.2 the campaign re-plans rather than scaling a losing method. Step 3 is a deliberate stop-gate: it is the cheapest possible falsification of the campaign's central engineering assumption.
provenance.prose_inaccuracy: CERTIFICATE_PLAN.md calls 0.2 'required for P5X-T4'; the frozen gate G3 requires only |R| < 2, i.e. half-width < 0.4096577169 at the binding cell
